claims: The 2026 Men's NCAA Tournament Elite Eight games are scheduled for Saturday, March 28, and Sunday, March 29.
Key tip-off times include 6:09 p.m. ET on Saturday.
Key tip-off times include 2:15 p.m. ET/4:05 p.m. CT on Sunday.
Coverage of the 2026 Men's NCAA Tournament Elite Eight games is on CBS and TBS/truTV.
The Saturday, March 28 matchup in the 2026 Men's Elite Eight is (9) Iowa vs. (2) Purdue or (1) Arizona.
The Sunday, March 29 matchup in the 2026 Men's Elite Eight is (2) UConn/(3) Michigan State vs. (1) Duke at 4:05 p.m. CT/5:05 p.m. ET (CBS).
The Sunday, March 29 matchup in the 2026 Men's Elite Eight is (2) Iowa State/(6) Tennessee vs. (4) Alabama/(1) Michigan at 1:15 p.m. CT.
Matchups are based on in-progress Elite 8 updates as of March 27-28, 2026.
